name: Ultra HD Smart Television X9000
description: Experience stunning clarity and vibrant colors with the TechVision Ultra HD Smart Television X9000. This premium TV features advanced QLED technology, delivering exceptional picture quality with deep blacks and bright whites. The smart platform gives you access to all your favorite streaming services, while the sleek design complements any living space.
highlights: 65-inch QLED display with 4K Ultra HD resolution
Smart TV platform with voice control
Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos support
Multiple HDMI and USB ports for connectivity

specifications.Smart Features: Voice Assistant, App Store, Screen Mirroring
specifications.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.0, HDMI 2.1 x 4, USB 3.0 x 3

features.title: Quantum Dot Technology
features.description: Experience a billion colors with incredible brightness thanks to Quantum Dot technology that delivers 100% color volume.

features.title: AI-Powered Upscaling
features.description: Our advanced AI processor automatically upscales content to near-4K quality, making even older content look amazing.

features.title: Gaming Mode Pro
features.description: Enjoy responsive gameplay with Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM), Variable Refresh Rate (VRR), and FreeSync support.

features.title: Smart Home Integration
features.description: Control your smart home devices directly from your TV with built-in voice assistant and IoT hub functionality.
